summary: The MaintProgramProfileDescription user control allows for the management of program profiles. It supports viewing, adding, editing, and deleting program details within a grid view. The control utilizes various ASP.NET Web Forms features such as GridView, FormView, ObjectDataSource, and UpdatePanel to manage the data. It also includes functionality for user session management, UI interaction, and data validation.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing program profiles, including viewing, editing, adding, and deleting program details.

workflows.name: Profile Management
steps: User views the profile list in the GridView (gvwProfile)
User can add a new profile via cmdAddEmptyData if no data present
User can edit an existing profile by selecting the edit command in the GridView
User can delete a profile via the delete command in the GridView
Changes are saved and the system updates the display

workflows.name: Popup Display
steps: User initiates a popup via btnShowPopup
User interacts with the popup content
System processes any actions and closes the popup

business_rules: Profiles must have a SortOrder, defaulting to -1 if not provided.
Only editable profiles allow adding, editing, and deleting.
Popups are shown only if specific criteria are met.
validations: Ensure that all fields are filled correctly before saving changes.
Validate data formats and required fields in GridView and FormView.
conditions: The grid header setup and action buttons depend on whether the screen is editable.
Row actions in the GridView depend on the row type (header or data row).
Redirect logic after save action based on whether changes are cancelled.
system_behavior: Redirect to another page with query string parameters after certain actions.
Process each row command (edit, add, delete) in the GridView to affect corresponding data.
Handle session state and caching related to user actions and data display.
dependencies: ASP.NET Web Forms features (GridView, FormView, etc.)
HSPnet session management and data layers
exceptions: JavaScript errors related to event validation when handling no data templates
